limits: Both original management parent functions run to return, including their loop and real/virtual transitions. This is not an EA, paired terminal comparison or complete manager integration proof.

All direct management helpers and underlying close/filling/send execute their actual bodies. Terminal queries, send replies and their specified provider-side position effects are supplied. IsStopped=0, logging=0, market execution=2 and filling flag=1; no complete branch/broker/account/EA claim, including every table-growth, full-table or allocation-failure path.
Native error-code/string/Print code executes. Successful string allocation and signed decimal conversion are supplied; double text is measured separately in MT5 and supplied by value bits.
CPU both-NaN fixtures only correct measured two-NaN arithmetic. Other native instructions run in Unicorn; no physical original-run, allocation-failure or complete error coverage claim.

Incoming R12 low-byte context is supplied explicitly for isolated manager calls. Caller mode executes the captured routing/counts with tick-management=1, override=0, validity=1 fixture inputs, then the actual managers and enabled table/trade helpers; no full EA/licensing/protected-byte change.
